docs.title: MirrorMaze
docs.text: Version 1.0.0. Built with ArgonSDK (Unreal Engine 4.25). Requires MirrorKit 1.0.0 or later.

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
MirrorMaze needs both PAKs:

  • MirrorMaze.pak (this map)
  • MirrorKit.pak (the mirrors; see the MirrorKit releases)

Copy both into Chivalry 2/TBL/Content/Paks/ and launch through the Unchained Launcher.

docs.title: Mirror quality
docs.text: The map uses MirrorKit's settings for mirror-heavy maps (the same as its High preset). You can change them for your own game with a launch option, for example -MirrorQuality=Low or -MirrorQuality=Ultra, and server hosts can set values for everyone, or an optional cap, in the map options. See Mirror quality in the MirrorKit README.

docs.title: Partner mirrors
docs.text: Twenty pairs of facing mirrors across the corridors are partnered: with partners on, each shows the other correctly, so the reflection inside the reflection continues the corridor like a tunnel. They are off by default (they cost extra). Turn them on for your own game with -MirrorPartners=1, or as a server host for everyone with ?MirrorPartners=1 in the map options. The Omega quality preset (-MirrorQuality=Omega) also turns them on. Comparison screenshots: MirrorKit quality options.
